topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't believe this. Finding a time capsule, something that’s supposed to be a piece of history, a snapshot of who we were, and it’s just... it’s not mine. I don’t even remember burying it. What’s the deal? Like, who does this? Just leaves something so personal, so significant, and doesn’t even acknowledge it? It’s like finding a letter you never wrote, a chapter of a book that’s supposed to be your life story, and it’s just... off. I mean, what are we supposed to make of this? It’s messing with everything, making me question stuff that should be solid, clear. This isn’t right, you know?
